name: Visitor Access
description: Manage expiring visitor grants through one Cloudflare Access email policy.

accountId.description: Cloudflare account containing the Access application.

appId.description: Access application whose dedicated visitor policy is managed.

apiToken.description: Resolved Cloudflare API token with Access policy read and write permissions.

policyName.description: Exact name of the only policy this plugin may manage.

defaultTtlDays.description: Default grant duration in days. Zero or null requires explicit days or forever on each invite.

maxVisitors.description: Maximum number of visitor emails allowed by this plugin.
